children: Capital One disclosed monthly charge-off and delinquency metrics for the month ended August 31, 2026, including card, auto and consumer loan balances and charge-off rates.
Domestic credit card average loans held for investment: $257,499 million; period-end: $260,642 million.
Domestic credit card net charge-offs: $892 million, net charge-off rate 4.16% (annualized).
30+ day performing credit card delinquencies: $9,297 million, rate 3.57% of period-end balances.
Auto loans average: $91,228 million; period-end: $91,886 million; net charge-offs: $126 million, rate 1.66%.
Auto 30+ day performing delinquencies: $4,171 million, rate 4.54%; nonperforming auto loans: $572 million, rate 0.62%.
